extracted.negative_finding_of_note: A targeted search restricted to investor.lilly.com, lilly.com, sec.gov and fda.gov for an orforglipron Complete Response Letter returned Lilly CRL press releases for empagliflozin (twice), lebrikizumab, donanemab, baricitinib and mirikizumab, but NONE for orforglipron. Lilly has a consistent practice of issuing a dedicated press release titled 'U.S. Food and Drug Administration Issues Complete Response Letter for X' whenever it receives a CRL. No such release exists for orforglipron.
